title: Shaker
summary: Shake effects for 2D and 3D: shaker nodes and presets that shake a node's position, rotation, and scale or any numeric property, with fades, plus area emitters.
useWhen: The game needs screen shake or object shake for juice: hits, explosions, landings, earthquakes, a trembling camera or UI element, or shake that grows near an explosion.
avoidWhen: A single short camera jolt is enough: a Tween on Camera2D.offset does it without an add-on.
